extracted.intended_audience: potential Parkinson's research volunteers (people with and without Parkinson's disease)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for people (with or without Parkinson's) on how to find and enroll in Parkinson's observational studies and clinical trials using MJFF tools and studies (PPMI, Fox Trial Finder, Fox Insight).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of people with and without Parkinson's disease
rubrics_metrics.description: The study needs people with and without Parkinson's disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple MJFF studies explicitly invite both people diagnosed with Parkinson's and people without the disease to participate; recruitment is not limited to patients only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of people recently diagnosed and people with risk factors
rubrics_metrics.description: People recently diagnosed with Parkinson's and people with Parkinson's risk factors can play a critical role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Studies (such as PPMI) seek participants across disease stages and risk profiles because early-stage and at-risk individuals provide important data for diagnosis, progression, and prevention research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a matching tool to find appropriate studies by location and traits
rubrics_metrics.description: Review studies that match your location and traits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Fox Trial Finder — a user-friendly online matching tool — to locate observational studies and clinical trials near you that match your personal characteristics (e.g., diagnosis status, demographics, other traits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to securely connect with researchers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When you find a study match (e.g., via Fox Trial Finder), the platform provides mechanisms to connect securely with study teams so you can learn more and consider enrollment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opt in for trial alerts via iConnect
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up for emails about new trials through iConnect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can receive email notifications about newly available studies that may suit your location/traits by registering for MJFF's iConnect service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate remotely via online self-report (Fox Insight)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our online clinical study collects self-reported data to learn more about life with Parkinson's. People with and without the disease can participate. Complete online questionnaires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fox Insight enables remote participation through online questionnaires and registration; it is suitable for people who can provide self-reported data without needing an in-person visit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urgency and impact of volunteering on trial feasibility
rubrics_metrics.description: 85 percent of trials face delays and 30 percent never get off the ground because of a lack of volunteers, resulting in a dramatic slowdown in progress toward a cure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Volunteer recruitment is a critical bottleneck; timely participation by eligible volunteers directly affects whether studies launch, stay on schedule, and can produce useful results.
